text: I am glad you agree that Chris Taldone's (KGF) idea of creating a
directory of employee cultural benefits for Kraft General Foods
employees in Chicago is a worthwhile project. And, as I mentioned
to you, perhaps creating a guide for each state would be useful for
Philip Morris employees throughout the country.
As you know, I forwarded to Chris the list Ellen Ng ran for me of all
the cultural organizations we contribute to by state, not including
KGF's contributions, as they handle theirs separately.
